question: Does selected normalized third-difference PLS smoothness S act as a calibrated indicator of relative spectral observation-noise attribution, independently varying observation noise and latent jerk volatility?

origins.model: Guerrero variance-ratio PLS; normalized S and joint REML from existing repository

selection.known_mu_reml: fixed true generative mean reference (oracle control only), continuous lambda search
selection.joint_reml: unknown constant mu, adjusted Gaussian REML, continuous lambda search
selection.global_ols_plugin_mle: global noisy training cubic OLS reference then conditional Gaussian profile likelihood, continuous lambda search
selection.gcv_zero_mu: fixed zero reference; same 15 normalized S candidates as earlier Paper C, observational alternative

precision_interpretation.primary_theory: trace((Cov(u)+Cov(D eps))^{-1} Cov(D eps))/(n-3) with true covariance matrices; model-correct only for iid jerk and iid noise (including constant mean)
precision_interpretation.misspecification: AR1 observations, AR1 jerk and randomized terminal contamination break iid Gaussian assumptions; sign reversal breaks constant jerk mean
precision_interpretation.true_observation_precision: 1 / sigma_epsilon^2 (Gaussian core); for terminal outlier the unconditional marginal endpoint variance is 17 * core variance
precision_interpretation.null_oracle: oracle S from known noise and jerk variance does not use observed data or fit any model

analysis.paired_noise_intervention: same jerk realization, same standardized observation noise, fixed jerk SD/structure/noise type/repetition; compare largest minus smallest position sigma
analysis.paired_jerk_intervention: same standardized jerk innovations and position noise, fixed observation SD/dynamics/noise type/repetition; compare largest minus smallest jerk SD
analysis.ratio_invariance: compare sigma_e=0.05,sigma_j=2 vs sigma_e=0.2,sigma_j=8 at same replicate/noise/dynamics, equal true variance ratio but different absolute noise precision
analysis.target_monotonic_noise: mean high-low S positive under model correct
analysis.target_monotonic_jerk: mean high-low S negative under model correct
analysis.cluster_unit: replicate parent draw (independent across stage, dynamic structure and repetition); all factorial cells within a parent treated as dependent
